test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - Reasoning (Held on: 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All drums are bells.

All whistles are bells.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some drums are whistles.

II. Some bells are drums.

III. Some bells are whistles.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Conclusions I, II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
According to the given statements we will get the Venn diagram as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bfe481b606c4df9910258d0ba3c58f557e7dcd73d23d30194e35d3977f946da.png] 

Let's check the conclusions below:

I. Some drums are whistles → Unfollow: Since there is no relation given between drums and whistles. This is not true.

II. Some bells are drums → Follow: Since given all drums are bells and so some bells are drums. This is true.

III. Some bells are whistles → Follow: Since given all whistles are bells and so some bells are whistles. This is true.

Thus, Both conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
